scripts.build:wasm: cd packages/core && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../sdk/src/wasm/pkg && cargo test export_rust_types --features ts-export
scripts.test: npm run test -w @org-hierarchy/sdk && npm run test -w @org-hierarchy/demo
scripts.test:verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run compare:nodes
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @org-hierarchy/sdk && npm run build:types -w @org-hierarchy/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @org-hierarchy/demo && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
